## Description

**What**: Update existing project docs that become stale after A0 lands — CLAUDE.md (architecture / quick reference), KNOWN-ISSUES.md (any auto-migration warning patterns), and any ADRs referencing the singular stack value.
**Why**: Future agents need accurate awareness of the new schema and its consumer query patterns.
**Scope**:
- IN: CLAUDE.md cross-link to DETECTION-SCHEMA.md and CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md v2; concise note on array-membership query pattern; remove or correct any singular-value references; KNOWN-ISSUES.md entry for EROFS fallback warn-log if recurring; ADR updates if any.
- OUT: New documentation files (skill creates updates only); restructuring CLAUDE.md beyond targeted updates.

## Done Definitions
- When complete, CLAUDE.md references DETECTION-SCHEMA.md and CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md v2 from architecture section ← Satisfies: SC5
- When complete, no doc retains the "singular stack value" framing as authoritative
- When complete, .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md formatting/structure is followed

## Considerations
- [Maintainability] Keep updates concise; do not duplicate schema content in CLAUDE.md (link, don't copy)

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: Update project docs to reflect the namespaced stack-array migration
